messages:
support: 1734456789 Customer support here — enterprise customer (acme-inc) reports p99 gen latency jumped from ~450ms to ~3s starting ~2026-03-16 03:00 UTC. They see errors/timeouts intermittently. They say it correlates with low QPS bursts and many different user prefixes. Requesting eng-runtime help, attaching sample request id 0a1b2c3d.

maria: 1734456910 can you paste the request id and a sample curl? also which model/route? i'll pull logs.

support: 1734456955 request id 0a1b2c3d, route /v1/generate, model: redwood-2.1-quant, sample curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"Hello","user_id":"u-123","prefix_id":"acct:acme:user:random"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

jonathan: 1734457002 looking at infra traces — big spike in kv cache miss rate for prefix keys across shard-6 between 03:00-03:20 UTC. p95 tokens service time jumps when kv miss ratio > 30%.

sasha: 1734457035 confirmed: logs show repeated KV GET miss; keys look high-cardinality: `prefix:acct:acme:user:...` — warmup not effective because that customer uses many short-lived prefixes. eviction churn observed; TTLs are ~5m.

maria: 1734457090 any recent changes to eviction policy or prefix normalization? deploy-bot, any config rollouts to cache-service in that window?

deploy-bot: 1734457100 deployment: cache-service v4.8 rolled at 2026-03-16T02:45:12Z to prod. change: experimental eviction smoothing disabled (flag: kv.eviction_smoothing=false).

jonathan: 1734457115 that's likely — smoothing prevented synchronous evictions; disabling it increased churn when cardinality spikes. we see eviction loops: item inserted -> evicted next batch -> reinsert -> thrash.

maria: 1734457128 repro steps to validate locally — run a short script to hammer many distinct prefix keys with intermittent QPS. sample repro (python): ```for i in range(10000): post('/v1/generate', {'prefix_id': f'acct:acme:user:{i%1000}', 'prompt':'x'})``` measure kv_miss_rate and p95.

sasha: 1734457150 quick mitigations I can push now: 1) re-enable eviction smoothing (kv.eviction_smoothing=true) 2) increase per-shard cache soft capacity by 20% 3) apply a temporary hot-prefix sticky policy for acct:acme (pin their prefixes to a hotset) — which ops needs approval for.

dinesh: 1734457172 ops here — can do smoothing and bump capacity now, sticky policy needs product ok for per-customer sticky pin. I'll queue the smoothing change and capacity bump to prod canary lane.

maria: 1734457180 also suggest short-term fallback: enable soft-kv-fallback so requests that miss repeatedly use decoded-kv fallback or slower model path to avoid p99 jumps. flag is `kv.soft_fallback=true`.

support: 1734457205 i'll tell acme we are working on it and ask them to avoid sudden multi-prefix flooded tests in meantime. they want ETA.

jonathan: 1734457220 estimated mitigation timeline: smoothing + capacity bump in canary within 10m, monitor for 30m, then roll to prod if good. sticky pinning needs a ticket and 1-day lead.

maria: 1734457242 instrumentation follow-ups: add per-route prefix_miss_histogram, and trace annotation mapping request-id -> kv-key for easier triage. also add alert when shard miss_rate > 15% and p95 > 1s for 5m.

sasha: 1734457260 pushed canary: kv.eviction_smoothing=true to shard-6 canary, capacity +20% on canary nodes. monitoring dashboard updated. link: https://console.redwood.internal/dash/shard-6

ops-bot: 1734457350 canary-check: kv_miss_rate dropped from 34% -> 9% on canary, p95 down 3s -> 480ms. no errors in 15m window.

dinesh: 1734457401 rolling smoothing + capacity to remaining prod shards; will also add a short ttl extension for prefixes from acct:acme to 15m as temporary measure.

maria: 1734457415 please capture full repro logs and KV key fingerprints. sasha can you grab a hotkey sample and we can add sticky pin config later.

sasha: 1734457428 grabbing logs now, sample keys: `prefix:acct:acme:user:435`, `prefix:acct:acme:session:abc123`, many variants. will create a follow-up RFC for prefix canonicalization and lower cardinality routing.

support: 1734457500 told acme about mitigation plan and ETA ~1h for full rollout. They appreciate quick response.

maria: 1734457522 longer-term work items (tracked): - prefix normalization (collapse user/session -> customer-level hash) - adaptive warmup: detect high-cardinality bursts and pre-warm small bloom filters - eviction policy opt: hybrid LRU+LFU with anti-thrash window - per-customer hotset pinning UI in console

jonathan: 1734457539 can we add an immediate protective rule: if per-request prefix entropy high, route to a low-latency fallback pool with more cache capacity? filing ticket.

maria: 1734457550 created issue RW-7282 (owner: sasha) for prefix canonicalization + RW-7283 for adaptive warmup (owner: jonathan). tagging product and solutions.

sasha: 1734457600 follow-up: sticky pin applied temporarily for acct:acme until 2026-03-17 06:00 UTC. monitoring continues.

support: 1734458200 customer confirms p99 back to normal in canary, will validate production. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: 1734458600 closing notes — summary: root cause eviction-smoothing flag turned off in v4.8 -> increased eviction churn for high-cardinality prefixes -> KV miss spike -> p95/p99 regressions. Immediate fix: re-enable smoothing + capacity bump + sticky pin for acme. Next actions: prefix canonicalization + adaptive warmup RFCs. Will write postmortem if this escalates to a Sev2.
